name: pyvista-wasm
postCreateCommand:
curl -fsSL https://herdr.dev/install.sh | sh && curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && sudo -H env "PATH=$PATH" uv pip install --system tox tox-uv pre-commit && uv python install 3.11 --default && npm ci && npm install -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent && python3 -c 'import json,pathlib; f=pathlib.Path.home()/".codespaces-user-secrets.env"; s=pathlib.Path("/workspaces/.codespaces/shared/user-secrets-envs.json"); d=json.load(open(s)) if s.exists() else {}; f.write_text("".join(f"export {k}={json.dumps(v)}\n" for k,v in d.items())); f.chmod(0o600)' && for f in ~/.bashrc ~/.zshenv ~/.zprofile ~/.profile; do grep -qs codespaces-user-secrets.env $f || printf '
[ -f ~/.codespaces-user-secrets.env ] && . ~/.codespaces-user-secrets.env
' >> $f; done && mkdir -p ~/.pi/agent && python3 -c 'import json,pathlib; f=pathlib.Path.home()/".pi/agent/settings.json"; d=json.loads(f.read_text()) if f.exists() else {}; d["defaultProvider"]="opencode"; d["defaultModel"]="glm-5.3-flash"; f.write_text(json.dumps(d, indent=2)+"\n")'
